title: Page FAQ Editor

fields.label: Editing this page’s FAQs
fields.message: This panel controls only the FAQ section near the bottom of the page. It does not change the rest of the design or content.

fields.label: FAQ section mode
fields.name: faq_mode
fields.instructions: Keep the current standard FAQs, replace them with the rows below, or hide the section completely.

choices.default: Use standard FAQs unless rows are added

fields.label: FAQ section heading
fields.name: faq_title
fields.instructions: Optional. Leave blank to keep the current heading.

fields.label: FAQ section introduction
fields.name: faq_sub
fields.instructions: Optional short paragraph shown below the FAQ heading.

fields.label: FAQ questions and answers
fields.name: faqs
fields.instructions: Add, remove, or drag rows to reorder questions. Select Custom FAQ rows above to use these rows.

description: Optional FAQ controls for plugin-owned WordPress Page templates.
